description: Get aggregated click, lead and sale analytics, grouped by a dimension such as country, device, referer or top links. The main reporting read. Dub: GET /analytics.

end.description: ISO-8601 end of an absolute range.

event.description: Which event type to report. Defaults to clicks.

groupBy.description: Dimension to group by, e.g. count, timeseries, top_links, countries, cities, devices, browsers, os, referers, utm_sources.

interval.description: Relative time window. Use start/end instead for an absolute range.

key.description: The short key, used with domain.

start.description: ISO-8601 start of an absolute range.

name: dub_get_analytics
title: Get analytics
